premises.text: Mental health need is large and many diagnosed people get no care; money alone fails to reach the most at-risk populations
premises.evidence_span: two in three of those diagnosed get zero care whatsoever

premises.text: Mobile text-based group psychotherapy combines anonymous peer support with therapist-moderated groups and scheduled VoIP sessions
premises.evidence_span: a mobile app for text-based group psychotherapy powered by natural language processing

premises.text: NLP flags suicidality and malicious content including latent and context-dependent risk so providers intervene when needed
premises.evidence_span: advanced NLP algorithms to run on user messages and detect messages containing suicidality or maliciousness that require immediate provider intervention

premises.text: B2B SaaS licenses the tech to organizations with provider infrastructure so end users get free care while institutions gain efficiency
premises.evidence_span: we deploy with the B2B SaaS enterprise model, where we license out this technology to organizations that already have an infrastructure of providers

premises.text: Safe tech-moderated groups combine relatability of peer communities without the toxicity of unmoderated social media
premises.evidence_span: we combine the best parts of all of these solutions by deploying the relatability of groups in an environment kept safe through technology

value.text: Broader access to safer, scalable psychotherapy that helps overburdened providers reach patients who need help when they need it
value.evidence_span: broaden access to care to patients, but also gives today's overburdened providers a means to scale to the true magnitude of this issue

secondary_value.text: Reduce crisis incidence and give institutions insight into population mental-health needs
secondary_value.evidence_span: detect complications early and reduce the number of crisis incidences within a population

causal_links.evidence_span: increase the efficiency of today's providers by allowing them to focus their time and energy on the users who need help
provide services to the end user at no charge to them

notes: §4.1.6: prevalence, zero care, first-responder/veteran examples, and VA reach failure folded as one access-pain bundle (P1). Demo anonymity/group size/VoIP facets folded into group therapy mechanism (P2). Competitor accessibility/toxicity map sharpens P5 rather than adding premises. Pilot commitments and $1.5B market excluded as traction/vision.
